judge_notes.opus5: Two sourced sides that nearly cancel: the lead hyperscaler's second device slipping from 'later this year' to 'calendar 2027' in an order press release is a real unpriced negative on the line this name trades on, but it agrees with a +11.75 put skew and sits against 17% of float short after a 49% sector-driven drawdown with visible Q1 orders, so only a small net positive survives.
judge_notes.opus55: Backlog plus in-quarter orders near the FY guide (i0/i1) and a 17% short after a 49% sector-driven drawdown (i4) outweigh the documented second-device slip (i2).
judge_notes.sonnet55: Q1 beat and visible bookings plus a 17% short and a 49% pullback into the print, against the hyperscaler device slip in the 10/07 PR; median reaction 22% so scale is large.
judge_notes.fable51: Announced orders lift FY27 visibility to ~$128m against a $130-150m guide (i1) while the stock halved on sector beta with 17% of float short (i4); the second-device slip to calendar 2027 (i2) is the real guidance risk and keeps the lean modest on a 15-22% mover.
